requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: All ambiguities regarding traffic scope, direction, and device nature are resolved via domain context and glossary. The requirement is structured as a single functional requirement describing the filtering capability of routing switches between data-plane and management traffic.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.

fields.affected_element: traffic flow between data-plane and management interfaces

scope_details.boundary: between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switches shall filter network traffic traversing the boundary between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: Resolved lexical ambiguity: 'switches' interpreted as hardware devices per domain context.
Resolved syntactic ambiguity: 'between' interpreted as defining the scope of the filter (boundary crossing) rather than a relationship between entities.
Resolved semantic ambiguity: Filtering scope covers traffic crossing the boundary generally, not restricted to unidirectional flow.
